country.evidence_quote: iAM Marketplace is operated by AM Marketplace GmbH and brings together three established AM entities: iSQUARED (founded 2009, Germany, a pioneer in alternative FDM materials), Forward AM (BASF’s 3D printing division, later an independent entity under Mass Additive Manufacturing GmbH), and Nexa3D (photopolymer and high-speed resin printing expertise). Together they represent decades of combined experience across polymer materials, engineering services, and additive manufacturing R&D.
